message.Title: Public Preview: Azure Container Apps introduces flexible workload profile

Body.Content:
Flexible workload profile represents a new option that blends the simplicity of consumption with many of the performance and control characteristics of dedicated workload profiles. This offers the same easy-to-understand, pay-per-use serverless model as Consumption, while adding features like planned maintenance windows, dedicated networking support, and access to larger replica sizes for demanding applications. Running in a single-tenant compute pool, this flexible workload profile provides improved predictability and isolation without adding operational complexity. This new profile is designed for customers who want the convenience of serverless scaling with greater control over performance and environment stability. 

Learn more.
